## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and the implementation choices that need
review.

## Validation

List the commands used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/architecture.md`.
- [ ] Behavior changes include regression tests.
- [ ] User-facing changes include documentation updates.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, customer media, or local profile data are included.
- [ ] New third-party material is compatible with the project and attributed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
